title: a real direct launch of a build without a budget ends brief.md with the direct rules that leave out the budget sentence, and its launch event has no budget
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, the v0.1.0 cut (budget is optional; the rules text drops the budget sentence)
intent: The same launch as launch/direct/brief-md-ends-with-the-direct-rules, with a build that has no `budget`: the card has no budget segment, the rules text keeps its four lines without the sentence that names the card's budget as the ceiling, and the launch event of the registry carries no `budget` key.
